svg.aria-label: agent-bus shown as a terminal dashboard. A Claude Code agent hands the client work to a Codex agent. Codex claims src/client.ts, does the work and sends it back; Claude checks it and approves. An OpenCode agent keeps out of the claimed file and asks you before dropping a table. A live bus log lists each step.
svg.title: agent-bus: Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode working together on one bus

text.tspan: every other step, the agents settled themselves

svg.text: Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode, each in its own window and worktree. One bus. No server.
